sections.A: MCL ghutne ko andar ki taraf jhukne se, LCL bahar ki taraf se, aur PCL pindli ko peeche khisakne se rokta hai.
sections.B: MCL: ghutne ke andar dard aur wahin sujan, mudne par dard. PCL: ghutne ke peeche dard, aksar aage se pindli par chot (dashboard ya girna).
sections.D: Effusion, ligaments ke saath dabana, range, taaza chot mein Ottawa knee rule, aur ligament stress tests.
sections.E: Valgus aur varus stress test (0 aur 30 degree par), posterior drawer, sag sign aur dial test.
sections.F: ACL rupture (pop, tezi se khoon wali sujan, Lachman positive) aur meniscus tear isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Kai ligaments dheele aur bari chot: ghutna utra ho sakta hai aur artery zakhmi, emergency. Foot drop: nerve ki chot.
sections.H: Fracture aur dislocation rule out karein, ligament ka grade dekhein. Akela grade I-II MCL: functional rehab. Bara ya mila jula: specialist.
sections.I: Shuru mein hifazat (grade II-III MCL mein hinged brace), sujan kam karna, quadriceps; phir range, taaqat aur khel.
sections.K: Shuru mein barf aur compression. Effusion, range, valgus dard aur quadriceps ki taaqat track karein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. Valgus 30 degree par khule to sirf MCL; 0 par bhi khule to zyada structures zakhmi hain.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
